findings.title: Moved and renamed symbols removed from mark_failed with no re-exports or test updates
findings.body: This PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence`, `SimpleCheckIn`, `get_failure_reason`, `get_monitor_environment_context`, and `HUMAN_FAILURE_STATUS_MAP` from `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed`, and renames two of them (`mark_failed_threshold` to `try_incident_threshold`, `create_issue_platform_occurrence` to `create_incident_occurrence`). Nothing is re-exported. Any remaining `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import ...` will fail with ImportError, and any `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")` or similar will fail with AttributeError. The changed-file list contains no test files. Either no references exist anywhere in the repo, which should be confirmed with a grep, or the test suite is left broken by this change.

findings.title: get_failure_reason docstring has a typo and examples that do not match the actual output
findings.body: The docstring says "humam readible" (typo). Its examples are also wrong. The two-category example at line 135 says "2 missed check-ins, 1 timeout check-in and 1 error check-in were detected", but the code produces "2 missed, 1 timeout and 1 error check-ins detected", since the per-status count is inside get_text_list and the suffix is applied once. The single-failure example at line 136 says "A failed check-in was detected", but no code path produces that string. The single-failure path returns "A missed check-in was detected", "An error check-in was detected", or "A timeout check-in was detected". The docstring was copied over unchanged during the move, so it now misdescribes the function that lives in its new module.
